title: Flight
author: Gary Tarolli and Rob Mace
blurb: SGI's flight simulator in its colour-index form, from the IRIS 4D demo tape: six aircraft, a 1280 by 1024 instrument panel composited in the bitplanes. Written in 1983 for the IRIS 1400; dog made it the first networked 3D game.
